Z000001.name: Clement Zablocki
Z000001.photoCredit: Biographical Directory of the United States Congress, Public domain (U.S. government work)
Z000001.bio: Clement Zablocki was a Democratic U.S. Representative for Wisconsin's 4th congressional district (1949–1983). Zablocki worked as an educator and served in the U.S. Air Force. Zablocki died in office in 1983.

Z000002.name: Leo C. Zeferetti
Z000002.photoCredit: Biographical Directory of the United States Congress, Public domain (U.S. government work)
Z000002.bio: Leo C. Zeferetti was a Democratic U.S. Representative for New York's 15th congressional district (1975–1983). Zeferetti served in the U.S. Navy.

Z000003.name: Herbert Zelenko
Z000003.photoCredit: Biographical Directory of the United States Congress, Public domain (U.S. government work)
Z000003.bio: Herbert Zelenko was a Democratic U.S. Representative for New York's 21st congressional district (1955–1963). Zelenko worked as a lawyer.

Z000004.name: Bill Zeliff
Z000004.photoCredit: Biographical Directory of the United States Congress, Public domain (U.S. government work)
Z000004.bio: Bill Zeliff was a Republican U.S. Representative for New Hampshire's 1st congressional district (1991–1997). Zeliff worked as a lawyer and businessperson and served in the U.S. Army.

Z000005.name: William T. Zenor
Z000005.photoCredit: Biographical Directory of the United States Congress, Public domain (U.S. government work)
Z000005.bio: William T. Zenor was a Democratic U.S. Representative for Indiana's 3rd congressional district (1897–1907). Zenor worked as a lawyer and judge.

Z000006.name: Edward D. Ziegler
Z000006.photoCredit: Samuel T. Wiley, editor. C. A. Ruoff Company (Philadelphia, PA), publisher., Public domain
Z000006.bio: Edward D. Ziegler was a Democratic U.S. Representative for Pennsylvania's 19th congressional district (1899–1901). Ziegler worked as a lawyer.

Z000007.name: Frederick Nicholas Zihlman
Z000007.photoCredit: Biographical Directory of the United States Congress, Public domain (U.S. government work)
Z000007.bio: Frederick Nicholas Zihlman was a Republican U.S. Representative for Maryland's 6th congressional district (1917–1931). Zihlman worked as a businessperson.

Z000008.name: Dick Zimmer
Z000008.photoCredit: Biographical Directory of the United States Congress, Public domain (U.S. government work)
Z000008.bio: Dick Zimmer was a Republican U.S. Representative for New Jersey's 12th congressional district (1991–1997). Zimmer worked as a lawyer.

Z000009.name: Orville Zimmerman
Z000009.photoCredit: Biographical Directory of the United States Congress, Public domain (U.S. government work)
Z000009.bio: Orville Zimmerman was a Democratic U.S. Representative for Missouri's 10th congressional district (1935–1948). Zimmerman worked as a lawyer and educator, served in the U.S. Army and was a veteran of World War I. Zimmerman died in office in 1948.

Z000010.name: Roger H. Zion
Z000010.photoCredit: Biographical Directory of the United States Congress, Public domain (U.S. government work)
Z000010.bio: Roger H. Zion was a Republican U.S. Representative for Indiana's 8th congressional district (1967–1975). Zion served in the U.S. Navy and was a veteran of World War II.

Z000011.name: Marion Zioncheck
Z000011.photoCredit: Biographical Directory of the United States Congress, Public domain (U.S. government work)
Z000011.bio: Marion Zioncheck was a Democratic U.S. Representative for Washington's 1st congressional district (1933–1936). Zioncheck worked as a lawyer. Zioncheck died in office in 1936.

Z000012.name: Felix Zollicoffer
Z000012.bio: Felix Zollicoffer was a U.S. Representative for Tennessee's 8th congressional district (1853–1859), changing party over time (Whig, then American). Zollicoffer was a veteran of the Civil War.

Z000013.name: Edward Zorinsky
Z000013.photoCredit: Biographical Directory of the United States Congress, Public domain (U.S. government work)
Z000013.bio: Edward Zorinsky was a Democratic U.S. Senator from Nebraska (1976–1987). Zorinsky served in the U.S. Army. Zorinsky died in office in 1987.

Z000014.name: Ed Zschau
Z000014.photoCredit: Biographical Directory of the United States Congress, Public domain (U.S. government work)
Z000014.bio: Ed Zschau was a Republican U.S. Representative for California's 12th congressional district (1983–1987). Zschau worked as an educator and businessperson.

Z000016.name: John M. Zwach
Z000016.photoCredit: Biographical Directory of the United States Congress, Public domain (U.S. government work)
Z000016.bio: John M. Zwach was a Republican U.S. Representative for Minnesota's 6th congressional district (1967–1975). Zwach worked as an educator.

Z000017.name: Lee M. Zeldin
Z000017.photoCredit: U.S. Government Publishing Office / unitedstates project, Public domain (U.S. government work)
Z000017.bio: Lee M. Zeldin was a Republican U.S. Representative for New York's 1st congressional district (2015–2023). Zeldin also served as Administrator of the Environmental Protection Agency (since 2025). Zeldin worked as a lawyer, served in the U.S. Army and was a veteran of the wars in Iraq and Afghanistan.

Z000018.name: Ryan K. Zinke
Z000018.photoCredit: U.S. Government Publishing Office / unitedstates project, Public domain (U.S. government work)
Z000018.bio: Ryan K. Zinke is a Republican U.S. Representative from Montana (2015–2017, since 2023). Zinke also served as Secretary of the Interior (2017–2019). Zinke worked as a businessperson and athlete, served in the U.S. Navy and was a veteran of the wars in Iraq and Afghanistan.
